vibe.verdict: Every line is true and the nationals concession stand fits, but the print shows dish names only, the East Compton Clovers are missing from the words, and the scoreboard and section map are stock stadium filler.
missing: The East Compton Clovers and Isis (the whole second half of the plot)
I'm sexy! I'm cute! I'm popular to boot! (Big Red's opening cheer)
The Clovers raising the nationals money through the talk show host
The final scores at nationals (Clovers first, Toros second)
ideas: Swap 'Sports drink on ice' for an East Compton Clovers drink, so the rival squad is on the board
Swap the scoreboard's Home and Guests rows for Toros and Clovers
Swap 'Red and white candy popcorn' for 'I'm sexy, I'm cute caramel popcorn' (Big Red's cheer)
Swap the stock 'Hawkers in every aisle. Catch it if you can.' for 'Stay in bounds. Hawkers in every aisle.'
